profile.headline: SSD Software Engineer at Solidigm Technologies
profile.jobTitle: SSD Software Engineer at Solidigm Technologies

positions.title: SSD Software Engineer at Solidigm Technologies
Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed utility tools, in python, to read and write to specified registers on the companies NAND PCIe SSD's to validate its critical data information
-Wrote, Automated, and Oversaw the Manufacturing Acceptance Tests (MAT), in python, bash, and C/C++, that thoroughly tested the company’s NAND PCIe SSD's which was deployed to an offsite manufacturing facility
-Notified software and hardware engineers about any discrepancies between actual and expected results of the companies data infrastructure software
-Communicated with NAND hardware engineers to further discuss what tests should be included in MAT (Manufacturing Acceptance Tests) to test the NAND PCIe SSD's on the manufacturing site
-Created, designed, and implemented the x86 server hardware infrastructure (master-slave set up) that is being used to test multiple NAND PCIe SSD's and then deployed the setup to an offsite manufacturing site

positions.title: Instrument Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed software to create and improve functional requirements on the company’s flagship product
-Implemented bash scripts to improve turnaround time for manufacturing technicians by 33%
-Oversaw the Intel Xeon Phi Stress Test software implementation that will be used on the companies genome-sequencing instrument
-Created test fixtures for the manufacturing technicians to test the internal hardware for the company’s genome-sequencing instrument
-Developed many manufacturing test plans (work instructions) for new hardware testing procedures
-Assisted in debugging x86 hardware server systems that were going to be incorporated into the company’s genome sequence instrument

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Created and revised Validation Tests, in C, for the IPMI Utility tool that’s being used within ORCM (Open Resource Cluster Manager)
-Implemented a sensor reading functionality that converted raw data into human readable data for ORCM

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Wrote Unit Level Tests in Linux for graphic software that was going to be implemented in future Intel products
-Generated and installed new certificates successfully 30 percent faster

positions.title: Intel Ultimate Engineering Experience Participant
positions.description:
Participated in a 6-week engineering program designed to provide technical hands-on engineering experience through a variety of technical skill development activities, team-based project work, competitions, professional skill development, networking and social activities
	- Designed and built a robot from programming to movement and sensors
	- Designed and programmed a computer game using C#
	- Ideation work which included experience working in teams and building problems-solving skills 
	- Used critical thinking to create technology-related solutions for local community issues

honors.title: Graduated with Honors - Cum Laude
honors.description: Graduated with honors- Cum Laude -at San Jose State due to my high GPA.

projects.title: Interactive Speaker System
projects.description: Worked on Senior Design Project that is intended to be an interactive speaker comprised of a Raspberry Pi 2, a database using MySQL, and custom circuitry to play audio

projects.title: Local Bar Database
projects.description: Created a web page for a bar database, using MySQL and PHP, to implement certain features such as available drinks, available ingredients, payment history, and order tabs
